item.title: 🔵 TNO067: The Impact of AI on Internet Traffic
item.description:
Why this matters: Hospitality system impact — check guest-facing services and PMS/POS status.

item.title: 🔵 An API for MoQ: provision your own isolated relays
item.description:
Why this matters: Leadership context — useful for risk, budget, and vendor conversations.
Last year we made every Cloudflare server a Media over QUIC (MoQ) relay. Now the new provisioning API lets you create your own isolated relay and control who can publish and who can only watch.
